note: This V1 can return DETERMINISTIC_CROSSWALK_MATERIALIZATION_REQUIRED only if a complete unique shared-anchor crosswalk is proven but no materialized crosswalk artifact exists. Because shared-anchor proof itself is exact, V1 classifies such a case as EXACT_CROSSWALK_PROVEN and leaves materialization to human review; no weaker mapping is promoted.
proof_rule: EXACT_CROSSWALK_PROVEN requires a shared Git-tracked non-outcome anchor containing identity/pair plus time, 100% exact-core key coverage, and zero duplicate keys in the source. Partial overlap, discovered offsets, fuzzy matching, pair-only identity, outcome fields and post-hoc relaxed coverage thresholds cannot prove a crosswalk.
